data.narrative:
Sierra Space, a Series C space and aerospace company founded by Fatih and Eren Ozmen, carries a current post-money valuation of $8.0B against $2B in total raised. The valuation sits within a comp universe of five public peers (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and eight private peers including Skyryse, SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Planet Labs at similar or adjacent stages.

Two valuation methods triangulate to a defensible range. Stage-progression modeling applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C-to-next-stage transitions, yielding $13.6B. Peer-median analysis across five same-sector comparables—spanning Skyryse at $1.1B (Series C) through Apex Space at $2.3B (Series D)—produces a median of $1.6B, with an interquartile range of $1.1B to $2.3B. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (25.3x median across the sector) cannot be applied due to lack of target revenue disclosure. The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.3B to $15.6B, with a median of $7.6B. The wide dispersion reflects the material gap between peer-derived floors and stage-progression ceilings, underscoring uncertainty around Sierra Space's revenue trajectory, customer concentration, and development milestones relative to the stated comparables.
